## Description

Collect one invoice with cash + UPI + card + advance in any combination; live remaining amount ("Balance remaining" / "Fully covered" / "Over-collected · reduce an amount"); confirming with a remaining balance moves it to Dues with a due date; log per method (received by, provider confirmed, card approved, advance adjusted).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Over-collection cannot be confirmed.
- [ ] **AC2.** Each split is a PAYMENT_SPLIT with its own state; the invoice is Paid only when all non-cash splits are confirmed.
- [ ] **AC3.** Remaining balance creates a DUE with due date and appears in dues (P-12).
- [ ] **AC4.** Advance usage reduces the advance balance atomically.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
